data.name: CASE VERIDIAN
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THE GAME

CASE: VERIDIAN is a first-person neo-noir psychological horror and investigative walking simulator. Step into the shoes of homicide detective Arthur Mace, sent to compile a final routine site report on the abandoned Veridian Opera House before its scheduled demolition.

On November 14, 1978, the grand opera house hosted the premiere of The Crimson King. During the performance, a massive fire broke out, and 140 people vanished without a single trace. The official reports called it a tragic accident and closed the case. Decades later, Arthur is about to discover that the fire was never an accident—and the building is still waiting for its final act.

---

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive Neo-Noir Atmosphere: Experience a dark, cinematic detective story driven by meticulous environmental exploration and an oppressive, shifting environment.

  • True Psychological Horror: No combat and no cheap jumpscares. Tension is built entirely through spatial anomalies, sound design, and creeping dread.

  • Investigative Puzzles: Piece together old operational logs, unearth forgotten clues, and solve grounded, logic-driven puzzles to navigate the labyrinthine corridors.

  • A Disturbing Time-Loop Narrative: Watch reality fracture as the boundaries between 1924, 1978, and the present day collapse into a single inescapable nightmare.

---

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

The developers describe the content like this:

This game features atmospheric psychological horror, dark themes, disturbing imagery, and isolated instances of strong language suitable for a mature audience.

data.short_description: Step into the charred ruins of the Veridian Opera House. Uncover a 1978 cold case, experience chilling psychological horror, and unravel a twisted reality where every solved mystery brings you closer to the fire. Can you escape the loop?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3 GB) veya AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10240 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX supported sound card
